description: This file defines the Category class within the OpenCart admin event controller namespace. It contains methods that hook into category-related actions (add, edit, delete) to add specific tasks for processing after these actions are performed, by interacting with the task model to enqueue background tasks.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: A controller class for handling event-driven tasks related to category management in the OpenCart admin.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Handles post-addition event, queuing tasks to update category list and info based on the new category ID.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Handles post-edit event, queuing tasks to update category list and info based on the edited category ID.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles post-deletion event, queuing tasks to update category list and process category deletion.
